div.head: Ine 42.1
div.ab: Gif þonne hryðera hwelc sie þe hegas brece ⁊ ga in gehwær, ⁊ se hit nolde gehealdan se hit age oððe ne mæge, nime se hit on his æcere mete ⁊ ófslea; ⁊ nime se agenfrigea his fél ⁊ flæsc ⁊ þolie þæs oðres.

If, however, it should be one of those heifers that breaks hedges and gets in everywhere, and [the owner] does not wish to or is not able to contain it, let him who finds it on his crop-field take it and kill it; and let the owner take its hide and meat, and forfeit the rest.

If, however, any beast breaks hedges and wanders at large within, since its owner will not or cannot keep it under control, he who finds it on his cornland shall take it and kill it. The owner [of the beast] shall take its hide and flesh and suffer the loss of the remainder.

Gif þonne hiyðera gehwilc sy ðæt hegas brece ⁊ ga in gehwær in, ⁊ se hit nolde gehealden, se (þe) hit age oþþe ne mæge, nime se (þe) hit on his æcere gemete ⁊ ofslea; ⁊ nime se agenfriga his flæsc ⁊ ðolige þæs oðres.
